text: Election of the Vice Chair of the North York Community Council under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting January 1, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022. All Members, including the incumbent, are eligible for election.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the January 13, 2021 meeting of the North York Community Council.
